timestamps.query: SELECT event,event_date,event_epoch,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_date) AS interpreted_epoch,UNIX_TIMESTAMP(event_date)-event_epoch AS delta_seconds FROM vicidial_user_log WHERE user='qaagent14' ORDER BY event_epoch; SELECT agent_log_id,event_time,pause_epoch,pause_sec,wait_epoch,wait_sec,talk_sec,dispo_sec FROM vicidial_agent_log WHERE user='qaagent14' ORDER BY agent_log_id;
